# Vendored Schemas

Vendored from <https://github.com/asyncapi/spec-json-schemas> at tag `v3.0.0`
(`schemas/3.0.0-without-$id.json`), so AsyncAPI document validation in tests works offline without
fetching the meta-schema over the network.

To refresh: download the same file at a newer tag from
<https://github.com/asyncapi/spec-json-schemas/tree/master/schemas>, replace it here, and update the
tag noted above.
